title: [v4,10/10] vfio/pci: Add mmap() attributes to DMABUF feature
summary: 该补丁为VFIO PCI设备的DMABUF导出功能新增内存属性控制接口，允许用户通过新增的ioctl命令设置后续mmap映射使用不可缓存或写组合属性，默认保持不可缓存，且不影响已有映射。
series_name: vfio/pci: Add mmap() for DMABUFs

title: [v4,01/27] VFIO: take reference to the KVM module
summary: 该补丁为VFIO框架在关联KVM时增加模块引用计数保护，在获取KVM安全引用及设备文件或组设置KVM时同步持有并管理KVM模块引用，防止KVM模块卸载引发竞态释放问题。
series_name: KVM: s390: Introduce arm64 KVM

title: [v8,2/6] vfio: selftests: igb: Use PHY internal loopback on 82576
summary: 该补丁将vfio的igb网卡selftest从依赖自协商和MAC环回改为配置82576的PHY内部环回，并保留RCTL.LBM_MAC作为QEMU模拟器专用兼容，从而让测试在真实硬件与QEMU下均可正常工作。
series_name: vfio: selftests: Add driver for Intel Ethernet Gigabit Controller (IGB)

title: [1/2] vfio/type1: Periodically try rescheduling when unmapping
summary: 该补丁在VFIO type1的取消映射与解绑循环中周期性调用cond_resched，每处理PUD_ORDER个页间隔主动让出CPU，以避免大量I/O地址映射解除时长时间占用处理器、提升系统整体调度响应性。
series_name: vfio/iommufd: Prevent scheduler warnings when unmapping large regions

title: vfio/type1: conditional rescheduling while unpinning
summary: 本补丁在 VFIO type1 的页取消固定流程中引入分批与条件调度，每次最多解除 64MB 映射后主动让出 CPU，防止大规模 DMA 映射拆除时触发软锁看门狗，改善了系统响应性。
series_name: vfio/type1: conditional rescheduling while unpinning

title: [rdma-next,09/15] vfio/mlx5: Enable relaxed ordering on the live migration data mkey
summary: 补丁为VFIO mlx5迁移数据内存键启用宽松排序，使分配内存键时依据设备能力设置该属性，以提升迁移时DMA性能，涉及命令分配路径。
series_name: [rdma-next,09/15] vfio/mlx5: Enable relaxed ordering on the live migration data mkey

title: [v1] vfio/pci: Avoid mapping BARs for devices with non-mappable BARs
summary: 此补丁在VFIO PCI核心的BAR映射流程中，跳过对存在不可映射BAR设备的映射操作，避免无效或错误的内存映射尝试。
series_name: [v1] vfio/pci: Avoid mapping BARs for devices with non-mappable BARs

title: [v7,01/23] vfio: Use file-based reference counting for KVM
summary: 该补丁将KVM页面追踪和VFIO引用计数从基于kvm指针改为基于kvm文件（file），用get_file/fput替代kvm_get_kvm/kvm_put_kvm，使VFIO设备生命周期通过文件引用管理，增强安全性。
series_name: KVM: s390: Introduce arm64 KVM

title: [RFC,1/1] vfio/pci: Disable sriov on PF device close
summary: 该补丁在VFIO PCI核心的PF设备关闭流程中，检测到存在活动VF时自动调用sriov_configure禁用SR-IOV，实现关闭PF即同步释放VF资源，避免虚拟功能残留。
series_name: vfio/pci: Disable sriov on PF device close

title: [RFC,v1,1/1] vfio/pci: Revoke BARs and DMABUFs during sysfs-triggered PCI reset
summary: 该补丁让 vfio-pci 在 sysfs 触发 PCI 复位时，通过新增的 reset_prepare/reset_done 回调在释放内存锁后统一撤销 BAR 映射和 DMA-BUF，并简化了多设备热复位路径的锁处理与撤销逻辑。
series_name: vfio/pci: Revoke BARs and DMABUFs during sysfs-triggered PCI reset

title: [v2] vfio: selftests: Add documentation
summary: 为 VFIO selftests 新增完整文档，纳入驱动 API 索引，详述测试运行、设备配置、清理流程及 libvfio 库结构，方便开发者编写和使用测试。
series_name: [v2] vfio: selftests: Add documentation

title: [v4] vfio/platform: prevent read-only region mappings from becoming writable

series_name: [v4] vfio/platform: prevent read-only region mappings from becoming writable

title: vfio/cdx: prevent read-only region mappings from becoming writable

series_name: vfio/cdx: prevent read-only region mappings from becoming writable

title: [v3] vfio/fsl-mc: prevent read-only region mappings from becoming writable

series_name: [v3] vfio/fsl-mc: prevent read-only region mappings from becoming writable

title: [v5,1/4] s390/vfio-ap: Fix leak of pinned NIB and registered NISC in vfio_ap_irq_enable/disable()

series_name: s390/vfio-ap: Fix pre-existing bugs in vfio_ap device driver

title: [1/4] vfio: Reject a second cdev open before mutating shared device state
summary: 该补丁将vfio字符设备禁止重复打开的限制从通用打开流程移到绑定iommufd时，在改动共享状态前检查打开计数并返回-EBUSY，避免二次绑定破坏已有持有者的VF令牌和kvm状态。
series_name: vfio: Fix cdev second-open and harden selftests

title: vfio/fsl-mc: keep logical vm_pgoff in MMIO region mmap
summary: vfio/fsl-mc 的 MMIO 区域 mmap 不再改写 vma->vm_pgoff，而是直接把物理地址换算的页帧号传给 remap_pfn_range，以保持逻辑偏移并避免干扰用户态映射。
series_name: vfio/fsl-mc: keep logical vm_pgoff in MMIO region mmap

title: vfio/platform: keep logical vm_pgoff in MMIO region mmap
summary: 该补丁在vfio平台驱动MMIO内存映射时，不再覆写vma的vm_pgoff字段，而是直接将计算出的物理页号传给remap_pfn_range，避免了破坏VMA的逻辑偏移，确保映射行为正确。
series_name: vfio/platform: keep logical vm_pgoff in MMIO region mmap

title: vfio/cdx: keep logical vm_pgoff in MMIO region mmap
summary: 该补丁调整 vfio/cdx 驱动 MMIO 区域 mmap 实现，不再覆盖 vma 的 vm_pgoff 字段，而是直接将该逻辑偏移传给 io_remap_pfn_range 以保留虚拟地址偏移语义。
series_name: vfio/cdx: keep logical vm_pgoff in MMIO region mmap
